stem: An ingestion pipeline for a ride-sharing company writes a new trip record to its relational database every time a ride starts or ends, far more often than anyone queries that data, and the database's write throughput has become the bottleneck during rush hour.

choices.text: Add a read replica to offload query traffic from the primary instance
Add an ElastiCache cache in front of the database for frequently read trip records
Increase the DB instance class and the storage's provisioned IOPS to raise write throughput
Convert the database to a Multi-AZ DB instance deployment with a standby in a second AZ

rationale: The bottleneck described is write throughput, so raising the writer's own compute and storage I/O capacity is the fix that relieves it. A read replica and an ElastiCache cache both move read traffic off the primary instance, but this pipeline writes far more than it is read, so neither touches the actual bottleneck. A Multi-AZ DB instance deployment adds a synchronous standby for failover; the standby does not serve traffic, and every write still goes through the single primary, so write throughput does not increase.
